# Smoothcraft image requests, tier 5: paintings

52 paintings, hung in the world. Each is re-imagined as a real oil
painting of the same scene, 16x the vanilla size (16 px per block becomes
256). The rules in [image-requests.md](image-requests.md) apply, except that a
painting is a picture, not a repeating texture. File:
`smoothcraft/mod/src/main/resources/resourcepacks/hd/assets/minecraft/textures/<texture>.png`.
